visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark brown hair, wearing a black Troxel riding helmet and a dark grey graphic t-shirt, records herself in a selfie-style shot. She is smiling excitedly with her mouth open. The background consists of a sandy trail, lush green tropical trees, and a glimpse of the ocean under a bright, sunny sky. (2) The scene shifts briefly to an older woman with short brown hair smiling at the camera, followed by a POV shot from the horse's back. A hand with multiple rings and a colorful beaded bracelet reaches out to stroke the light brown mane of a horse named Rusty. The setting is a dirt trail with pine needles and shadows. (3) A picturesque view of turquoise ocean waves crashing against dark, rocky shores. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds. Green pine trees and palm leaves frame the edges of the shot, emphasizing the coastal tropical environment and high-contrast natural lighting. (4) POV footage of riding the horse through a wooded area with dense green bushes and tropical plants. The rider's hand is seen holding a black rope rein. Another rider on a white horse is visible further ahead on the trail. Sunlight filters through the canopy. (5) A low-angle shot shows the rider's leg in black trousers and a black boot placed in a green-trimmed stirrup. The horse stops to eat green leaves from a bush. The rider's hand reaches down to pat the horse's neck as it leans towards the vegetation. (6) A wide-angle shot from behind shows the woman on the brown horse at the edge of the rocky coastline, holding a long selfie stick to capture the scenery. Massive white waves crash in the background against a deep blue sea. (7) Quick cuts show a man on a brown horse smiling, and the woman riding through a shaded grove with another person behind her. Then, shots of horses in a fenced paddock area with a white fence and a red barn-style building in the background. (8) The woman stands in front of a red building labeled 'The Stables', speaking directly to the camera while gesturing. She is no longer wearing the helmet, and her hair is slightly windswept. The background shows trees and other visitors in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female voice speaking Chinese enthusiastically over a driving electronic pop BGM with a strong beat (~128 BPM). Faint outdoor ambient wind noise and a low-frequency hum from the ocean are audible in the background mix. (2) A sharp vocal cheer occurs as the speaker reacts to the horse. The BGM swells with added synthesizer layers. A loud, broadband SFX of crashing waves is introduced, momentarily competing with the primary vocal signal. (3) The vocal tone shifts to a moderately fast instructional style. Continuous BGM provides a rhythmic bed. Subtle incidental sounds of clothing rustling and soft, rhythmic thudding from the horse's footsteps on sand are clearly perceptible. (4) A sudden vocal inflection occurs as the speaker playfully scolds the horse. A distinct 'No, no, no' in English is heard. The BGM maintains its tempo. Audible rustling SFX from the rider adjusting their position is recorded. (5) Heavy ambient wind noise impacts the microphone, creating a noticeable but brief spectral burst. The sound of waves is prominent. A short, low-arousal vocal exchange in English between a man and a woman follows, underlaid by steady BGM. (6) The video concludes with energetic summary narration. Digital UI sound effects, including high-pitched dings and bubble pops, are synchronized with the fast-paced speech. The BGM continues at a consistent volume until a sharp final cut.
